method: Original M68000 core-cycle lower bounds, rounded up to the next PAL refresh; minimum sampled workload per screen. Browser baselines retain at least three refreshes.
limits: No DMA, IRQ, audio interrupt, OS-call or VBL-wait overhead.
Fixed neutral entry, deterministic initialized RNG and original invulnerability gate; later actors and player actions can require more time.
These are scene-dependent lower-bound baselines, not hardware-exact frame schedules.
